{{Short description|French mathematician (born 1953)}}

[[File:Henniart Le Gall.jpg|thumb|Henniart (right) with [[Jean-François Le Gall]] at the 2006 [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Madrid, Spain.]]
'''Guy Henniart''' (born 1953, [[Santes]]) is a French mathematician at [[Paris-Sud 11 University]]. He is known for his contributions to the [[Langlands program]], in particular his proof of the [[local Langlands conjecture]] for [[General linear group|GL(''n'')]] over a ''p''-adic [[local field]]—independently from [[Michael Harris (mathematician)|Michael Harris]] and [[Richard Taylor (mathematician)|Richard Taylor]]—in 2000.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Henniart |first=Guy |author-mask=3 |title=Une preuve simple des conjectures de Langlands pour ''GL(n)'' sur un corps ''p''-adique |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |volume=139 |issue=2 |year=2000|pages=439–455 |doi=10.1007/s002220050012 |bibcode=2000InMat.139..439H |s2cid=120799103 }}</ref>

Henniart attained his doctorate from the [[University of Paris V]] in 1978, under supervision of [[Pierre Cartier (mathematician)|Pierre Cartier]] with thesis ''Représentations du groupe de Weil d’un corps local''. He was a member of [[Nicolas Bourbaki]].<ref>{{citation|title=Bourbaki: a secret society of mathematicians|first=Maurice|last=Mashaal|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|year=2006|page=17|isbn=978-0-8218-3967-6|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-CXn6y_1nJ8C&pg=PA17}}.</ref> Henniart was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2006 at Madrid and gave a talk ''On the local Langlands and Jacquet-Langlands correspondences''.

* with [[Colin Bushnell]]: {{cite book|title=The local Langlands conjecture for GL(2)|publisher=Springer-Verlag|year=2006|isbn=3-540-31486-5|series=Grundlehren der mathematischen Wissenschaften|volume= 335}}
